title: Spicy Thai Noodle Soup
description: A hearty and spicy Thai noodle soup made with rice noodles and a flavorful broth. Serve with your favorite toppings.
instructions: 1. Bring the chicken broth to a boil in a large pot.
2. Add the Thai red curry paste and Thai green curry paste. Stir to combine.
3. Add the rice noodles and cook according to the package instructions.
4. Add the fish sauce and stir to combine.
5. Taste and adjust the seasoning as needed.
6. Serve the noodle soup hot, garnished with Thai basil leaves.
7. Optional: top with your favorite toppings, such as sliced chicken or tofu.
